caption:
बॉलीवु़ड के गलियारों से आ रही है एकदम मसालेदार और धमाकेदार खबर! 🎬
हुंगामा डिजिटल मीडिया एंटरटेनमेंट और T-Series ने हाथ मिलाकर एक नया माइक्रो-ड्रामा प्लेटफॉर्म FastTV लॉन्च किया है।
इस नए वेंचर में दोनों कंपनियों ने 300 करोड़ रुपये का भारी निवेश किया है, जिसका ऐलान 17 नवंबर 2026 को मुंबई में हुआ।
कंपनी का दावा है कि यह प्लेटफॉर्म मोबाइल यूजर्स के लिए खास ओरिजिनल कहानियां लाएगा, जिन्हें कई भाषाओं और जॉनर में तैयार किया जाएगा।
रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, पिछले साल ग्लोबल लेवल पर इस फॉर्मेट का रेवेन्यू 11 बिलियन डॉलर तक पहुंच गया था और 2026 के अंत तक इसके 14 बिलियन डॉलर पार करने की उम्मीद है।
हुंगामा के फाउंडर और सीईओ Neeraj Roy का कहना है कि भारत को एक ऐसे प्लेटफॉर्म की जरूरत है जो मोबाइल पर देखने के तरीके के हिसाब से बना हो।
वहीं T-Series के चेयरमैन और मैनेजिंग डायरेक्टर Bhushan Kumar का कहना है कि इस पार्टनरशिप से क्रिएटिव एक्सीलेंस और स्केल को बढ़ावा मिलेगा।
यह ऐप फिलहाल App Store, Google Play और वेब पर उपलब्ध है और इसे भारत समेत 190 देशों में ले जाने की योजना है।
क्या आप भी मोबाइल पर ऐसे छोटे शोज देखना पसंद करेंगे? 📱

ctx.text:
The joint venture will focus on original mobile-first stories across genres and languages, using AI-powered technology to support production, localisation and personalised viewing.
Hungama Digital Media Entertainment and T-Series have joined hands to launch FastTV, a new micro-drama platform aimed at expanding India's presence in the rapidly growing short-form entertainment segment. The two companies have committed Rs 300 crore to the joint venture, which will focus on developing original content, strengthening technology and expanding its customer base.
Announced in Mumbai on November 17, 2026, FastTV aims to build a platform dedicated to micro-dramas, with stories created specifically for mobile viewers. The format has witnessed considerable growth globally, with revenues reaching $11 billion last year and expected to cross $14 billion by the end of 2026. In India, two out of every three viewers discovered micro-dramas over the past year, indicating growing interest in the format.
The platform will feature original stories developed by writers, directors and performers from the Indian film and television industries. The content will cover multiple genres and languages, with short episodes designed for viewers to watch in a single sitting. FastTV also plans to make its stories accessible across India and 190 countries, targeting audiences familiar with Indian entertainment.
Hungama brings over two decades of experience in digital entertainment. The company has developed services across music, video, gaming and immersive media, reaching more than 300 million users through partnerships with technology platforms. It has also been strengthening its focus on artificial intelligence, supported by an in-house AI studio and technology infrastructure designed for mobile-first entertainment.
T-Series, meanwhile, brings its experience in film production and music to the venture. With over 180 films to its credit, the company has established its presence across film production and music distribution. Its understanding of cinema and music is expected to contribute to the creative direction of FastTV, with original compositions and soundtracks forming part of the platform's content.
Hungama developed the FastTV platform and its patent-applied AI production technology over the past 18 months. The technology is designed to support content development, production and localisation across multiple languages. It will also enable personalised viewing recommendations based on individual preferences.
Neeraj Roy, Founder and CEO of Hungama Digital Media Entertainment, said, “India does not need another Micro Drama app. It needs a company built for the way a billion people now watch: stories written for the phone, told in minutes and made to travel. For two decades Hungama has taken Indian entertainment to the world and micro-drama is the first format where India can lead rather than follow. With T-Series as an equal partner, FastTV has the storytellers, the music, the technology and the reach to do exactly that. The next era of entertainment will not be one story for everyone. It will be the right story for each person, on the screen they carry everywhere. FastTV is built for that: Indian storytelling at its best, on a platform that learns what moves you.”
Speaking about the collaboration, Producer Bhushan Kumar, Chairman and Managing Director of T-Series, added, “At T-Series, we have always been driven by the instinct to recognize stories and formats that have the potential to connect with people. Our partnership with Hungama brings together complementary strengths, with a shared vision to build creative excellence and scale in this space. We see immense potential in combining compelling storytelling, world-class music and technology to create a distinctive viewing experience. With FastTV, our endeavour is to develop a strong Indian content ecosystem that can resonate with audiences not just in India, but across the world.”
